about_the_game:
A set of useful items to try out for free.

● Free Sample Set Vol. 1
　- Teara Balm x1
　- EP Charge II x1
　- Celestial Balm x1
　- Shard Tokens x1000
● Free Sample Set Vol. 2
　- Shining Pom Bait x1
　- Zeram Powder x1
● Free Sample Set Vol. 3
　- Vitality Droplet x1
　- Power Droplet x1
　- Fortitude Droplet x1
　- Magic Droplet x1
　- Spirit Droplet x1

- Items can also be obtained through normal gameplay.
- Items can be redeemed by selecting the added bundle(s) from the DLC tab under 'Items' in the Main Menu in-game.
- Please note that if you exceed an item's maximum quantity limit in your inventory, the excess amount will be discarded.
